name: carp 2000
_comment: Instrument: semi-modular synth in the manner of the ARP 2600 (carp_core.h), phases 1 + 2 = monophonic voice with modulation matrix. vst.json/module.json only feed mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin. The plugin is carp_vst.cpp, built by this port's own build.sh.
